Alchemist.name: Bomb Thrower
Alchemist.html: Bomb Thrower: The effective range for Bomb Throw is raised to 6, and the maximum range is raised to 8. See "Bomb Throw" in the "Actions" chapter for full description.

Alchemist.name: Unstable Bombs
Alchemist.html: Unstable Bombs: The Alchemist can create an Unstable Bomb to be used with the Bomb Throw as part of the action itself. Unstable Bomb: As you commit to the Bomb Throw action, choose one of the following effects: Area: 3-units cube Choose acid or fire. Roll Bomb Throw against Deflection. Threshold is 1. Any creature within the area that you've succeeded against receives 1 damage of the type you chose. Area: 3-units cube The area is filled with purple smoke. Creatures in the smoke cannot see outside of it and have half cover against ranged attacks of any kind.

Alchemist.name: Curious Concoctions
Alchemist.html: Curious Concoctions: Start each day with 4 Concoction Points (CP). Create your known concoctions outside combat by spending their CP costs; each takes a few minutes to prepare and lasts only for the current day. Multiple uses of the same concoction do not stack.

Archer.name: Martial Weapons Proficiency
Archer.html: Martial Weapons Proficiency: You may use martial weapons.

Archer.name: Bullseye
Archer.html: Bullseye: When you roll Double 6 on a Ranged Strike, roll 2 Extra Dice and add their successes to that roll.

Archer.name: Special Shots
Archer.html: Special Shots: You gain the Pinning Shot and Puncturing Shot Ranged Strike variants.

Archer.name: Sliding Shot
Archer.html: Sliding Shot: You gain the Sliding Shot action.

Barbarian.name: Martial Weapons Proficiency
Barbarian.html: Martial Weapons Proficiency: You may use martial weapons.

Barbarian.name: Push Through Pain
Barbarian.html: Push Through Pain: You start each combat with 3 temporary hit points. At the end of the combat, you lose all temporary hit points.

Barbarian.name: Rage
Barbarian.html: Rage: Start each combat with 1 Rage. Gain 1 Rage whenever you damage an enemy, and 1 Rage per HP lost, including temporary HP. Spend Rage on your abilities; lose all unspent Rage when combat ends.

Barbarian.name: Ram
Barbarian.html: Ram: You gain the Ram Charge variant.

Barbarian.name: Aggressive Grapple
Barbarian.html: Aggressive Grapple: You gain the Aggressive Grapple Grapple variant.

Barbarian.name: Enraged Toss
Barbarian.html: Enraged Toss: You gain the Enraged Toss Weapon Throw variant.

Barbarian.name: Angry Mind
Barbarian.html: Angry Mind: Rolls for attacks and effects against you that cause the Discouraged or Frightened conditions have disadvantage.

Bard.name: Bardic Music
Bard.html: Bardic Music: You can play any musical instrument and add magical sounds to musical performances. You have advantage on Performance rolls for music.

Bard.name: War Singing
Bard.html:
War Singing: During the Beginning Phase, choose one phrase not yet used this combat. This requires no action. It affects creatures within 6 units at that moment for the round, even if they later move.

  • Rise to the Challenge: All affected allies become Inspired 1 (1 Extra Die on rolls) until the end of the round.
  • Onward We Go: All affected allies gain +1 Movement until the end of the round.
  • Looming Darkness: Roll Magic against each affected enemy’s Will. On success, it becomes Discouraged until the end of the round.

Bard.name: Enchanted Melodies
Bard.html: Enchanted Melodies: Outside combat, perform Melody of Rest once per day to heal party members within 20 units for 1 HP.

Bard.name: War Singing phrases
Bard.html:
• Sweet, Sweet Revenge: Choose an enemy that damaged you this combat. It becomes Vulnerable and Discouraged until the end of the round.
  • For Our Friends: If a party member became Dying this combat, affected allies gain advantage on all rolls until the end of the round. Dying party members gain advantage on their stabilization roll.

Cleric.name: Domain
Cleric.html: Domain: Your chosen domain determines your domain damage type and opposition.

Cleric.name: Blessed Strike
Cleric.html: Blessed Strike: Your Melee Strikes are blessed by the divine. When you perform a Melee Strike using a one-handed weapon, you may use your Magic bonus for the roll instead of your Melee bonus. You may choose to deal Radiant or your Domain damage instead of the weapon’s damage type.

Cleric.name: Prayer
Cleric.html: Prayer: Start each combat with 1 Faith and gain 1 Faith whenever you perform an action. Spend Faith on Prayer options; see the Prayer action.

Druid.name: Student of the Wild (1 / Combat)
Druid.html: Student of the Wild (1 / Combat): Reveal the action of one beast or elemental enemy (no action needed, before committing to a course of action)

Druid.name: Wild Shape
Druid.html: Wild Shape: While shapeshifted, use your form’s senses, features, Movement, Deflection, Fortitude, Athletics, Acrobatics, and melee range. You can speak with animals but cannot speak normally, use armor or weapons, or cast spells or cantrips. Existing spells continue. Animal Strike is your only Strike action; its damage type and Double 6 effect depend on your form.

Paladin.name: Martial Weapons Proficiency
Paladin.html: Martial Weapons Proficiency: You may use martial weapons.

Paladin.name: Devotion
Paladin.html: Devotion: You have a pool of 3 devotion points. You may spend them to power certain abilities. Your pool fills when you rest. Your pool gets larger as you level up.

Paladin.name: Holy Smite
Paladin.html: Holy Smite: You gain the Holy Smite Melee Strike variant.

Paladin.name: Inspiring Strike
Paladin.html: Inspiring Strike: Whenever you successfully perform a Melee Strike, choose an ally within 10 units of you. They become Inspired 1 (1 Extra Die on rolls) until the end of the round

Ranger.name: Hunter's Edge
Ranger.html: Hunter's Edge: On the first round of combat, your Melee Strikes and Ranged Strikes have advantage against enemies that have not yet acted.

Ranger.name: Favored Enemy
Ranger.html: Favored Enemy: Choose one category of creatures as favored enemy: Abominations, Beasts, Dragons, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, Giants, Oozes, Plants, Undead. You gain 2 Extra Dice on Melee Strike and Ranged Strike rolls against enemies of the chosen type. You gain advantage on Deduction, Stealth, Survival, Nature, and Notice Movement rolls against enemies of the chosen type. You may choose a new favored enemy type to replace the current one. To do so, you must first spend a week of downtime to learn about it.

Ranger.name: Know Your Enemy (1 / Combat)
Ranger.html: Know Your Enemy (1 / Combat): During the Planning Phase, reveal the action of one enemy of the favored enemy type.

Rogue.name: Sneak Attack
Rogue.html: Sneak Attack: When you have advantage on a Melee Strike or Weapon Throw, add 3 Extra Dice to the roll. None of the weapons used for the attack may have the Heavy, Reach, or Two-Handed properties.

Rogue.name: Slippery
Rogue.html: Slippery: You gain +1 Deflection if you are not wearing Medium or Heavy armor and are not wielding a shield or a 'Heavy' weapon.

Rogue.name: Lockpicking
Rogue.html: Lockpicking: You have proficiency with Thieves Tools.

Rogue.name: Basic Dual Wielding
Rogue.html: Basic Dual Wielding: Wield two one-handed weapons, at most one Heavy. Make one Melee Strike roll using both weapons’ Extra Dice, the higher Minimum Roll, one available damage type, and one weapon’s Double 6 effect.

Spellsword.name: Martial Weapon Proficiency
Spellsword.html: Martial Weapon Proficiency: You may use martial weapons.

Spellsword.name: Arcane Strike
Spellsword.html: Arcane Strike: Whenever you perform a Melee Strike with a one-handed weapon, you may choose one type of element: lightning, fire, or ice. Gain 2 Extra Dice on the roll. The Melee Strike's damage type becomes the chosen type.

Spellsword.name: Arcane Diffusion
Spellsword.html: Arcane Diffusion: Whenever you cast any arcane cantrip or spell, you get a +1 Deflection bonus until the end of the next two rounds. Casting an arcane spell or cantrip while the bonus is active refreshes the duration, but the +1 Deflection bonus does not stack with itself. This feature is not triggered by spells or cantrips that grant a Deflection bonus by themselves.

Warrior.name: Martial Weapons Proficiency
Warrior.html: Martial Weapons Proficiency: You may use martial weapons.

Warrior.name: Student of War (1 / Combat)
Warrior.html: Student of War (1 / Combat): During the Planning Phase, reveal the action and its targets of one humanoid enemy.

Warrior.name: Tactical Strike
Warrior.html:
Tactical Strike: Once per round, when you succeed on a Melee Strike, you may choose to apply one of the effects in the list below:

Push: force push the target 1 unit in any direction

Breach: the target is Breached (-1 Deflection) until the end of the next round

Disable: apply disadvantage to the target's next attack

Reposition: Move 1 unit.

Trip (-1 damage): target becomes Prone if it's up to one size larger than you.

Occultist.name: Occultist’s Familiar
Occultist.html: Occultist’s Familiar: You gain a magical familiar. Its form is of a tiny animal or demon. It can’t perform actions in combat other than the Dash action. It is incorporeal (it can’t be affected by anything, but can’t go through obstacles or walls), and demonic in its nature. It has 1 Deflection and 1 HP. You may choose to cast a spell from the familiar as if you were standing there. Doing so makes it corporeal for the rest of the battle. If it would die it is banished instead. You may perform a ritual during a long rest to bring it back if it’s banished. It may take a new form when you do. You may also perform this ritual if it’s not banished to change its form. The familiar understands and speaks one language of your choice from those you know. It may speak normally, letting others in your surroundings hear it, or speak telepathically to you. You may also speak to it telepathically. The range of the telepathy is 60 units.

Wizard.name: Student of Magic (1 / Combat)
Wizard.html: Student of Magic (1 / Combat): During the Planning Phase, you may reveal if a spell is being cast by a chosen enemy, and what that spell is.

Wizard.name: Fae Familiar
Wizard.html: Fae Familiar: You gain a magical familiar. Its form is of a tiny animal or Fae. It is incorporeal (it can’t be affected by anything but can’t go through obstacles or walls) and is considered a Fae. The familiar understands and speaks one language of your choice from those you know. It may speak normally, letting others in your surroundings hear it, or speak telepathically to you. You may also speak to it telepathically. The range of the telepathy is 60 units. It has 1 Deflection, 1 HP, and 5 Movement. It can’t perform actions in combat other than the Dash action. You may choose to cast a spell from the familiar as if you were standing in its place. Doing so makes it corporeal for the rest of the combat. If it dies it is banished instead. During a long rest you may perform a ritual to bring it back if it’s banished. It may take a new form when you do. You may also perform this ritual even if it’s not banished to change its form. You may spend 2 Spell Points to perform a quick version of this ritual that only takes a minute.

Zephyr.name: Martial Arts Disciple
Zephyr.html: Martial Arts Disciple: Gain 2 Extra Dice on Unarmed Strike rolls and Melee Strike rolls using daggers. You may roll with the Unarmed skill when you perform a Melee Strike with daggers and quarterstaffs.

Zephyr.name: Wind Walk
Zephyr.html: Wind Walk: While not wearing armor, holding a shield or wielding a 'Heavy' weapon: Gain +2 Movement. You may move through enemies' space (You cannot end your movement in another actor's space). Gain +1 Deflection. When you move at least 4 units and end your movement at least 2 units away from your starting position, gain additional +1 Deflection until the end of the current round (including when you move as part of an action that uses movement)

Zephyr.name: Momentum
Zephyr.html:
Momentum: You start each combat in Momentum tier 1. At the end of each round, if you moved at least 4 units during that round, you gain 1 tier of Momentum (maximum tier 3). When combat starts and whenever you gain a tier, roll Unarmed to determine the additional benefit you get from your new tier. See the table at the bottom. Whenever you receive damage, you lose one tier (minimum tier 1). All associated benefits of the tier you lost are lost as well.

Shadow Clone: When you get the Shadow Clone benefit, you immediately create a clone of yourself in a nearby location that is closest to you. The clone is a separate actor you control in a similar manner. The clone shares your Movement score and your Unarmed bonus. The clone can only perform Unarmed Strike, dealing the same damage as you normally deal. It doesn't get the Strike damage benefit from Momentum. The Shadow Clone cannot be affected or damaged. If you lose the ability or become unconscious, or if the clone moved less than 4 units during the round, the clone dissipates.

Whirlwind: When you get the Whirlwind benefit, starting next round, at the end of each round, you create a slashing wind around you. Roll Unarmed against Deflection for all enemies that are adjacent to you. Deal 1 Slashing damage to each enemy you succeed against.

Gale: When you get the Gale benefit, starting next round, during the Beginning Phase of each round, choose two targets you can see within 10 units of you that are up to one size larger than you. You may forcefully push them up to 2 units. This also counts as 1 damage for the purpose of interruption.

  • Tier 1 — 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 SD: +2 Movement / strikes force-push 1 unit / strikes apply Prone / choose a Tier 1 benefit.
  • Tier 2 — 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 SD: Gale / Whirlwind / Shadow Clone / choose a Tier 2 benefit.
  • Tier 3 — 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 SD: Strikes gain 4 Extra Dice and deal Slashing / same / strikes gain 4 Extra Dice and deal Force / choose an unused benefit from any tier.

Zephyr.name: Agile Fall
Zephyr.html: Agile Fall: Halve the damage you receive from fall damage (rounded down). Also, you start to receive fall damage after falling 4 units instead of 2

Zephyr.name: Deflect Missiles
Zephyr.html: Deflect Missiles: Once per round, when hit with a Ranged Strike or a Weapon Throw, you may change the target of the attack to another target within 5 units of you. If you don't choose such target, you may avoid the attack instead.

Zephyr.name: Forceful Maneuver
Zephyr.html: Forceful Maneuver: You gain the Forceful Maneuver action.

Skald.name: Art of Fighting
Skald.html: Art of Fighting: You gain proficiency with martial weapons, heavy shields, and medium armor.

Muse.name: Glamorous Spellcasting
Muse.html: Glamorous Spellcasting: You get 1 temporary Spell Point when combat starts. It can only be used to perform non-damaging spells. When you use it that way, you get 1 Extra Dice for the roll. At the end of combat, you lose unspent temporary Spell Points from this feature.

Exarch.name: Divine Conduit
Exarch.html: Divine Conduit: You may perform Prayer one additional time per combat. You also get the following option for Prayer: Alacrity [Costs 1 Faith]: Your party members get +2 Movement until the end of the round.

Hierophant.name: Divine Messenger
Hierophant.html: Divine Messenger: You learn the Thaumaturgy cantrip. If you already know it, you learn another Divine cantrip of your choice. Casting Thaumaturgy requires no time or effort, and you may do so any time you could normally speak. When you cast it, you can choose as many of its effects as you wish as part of a single casting.

Hierophant.name: Commanding Presence
Hierophant.html: Commanding Presence: You know and have access to the powerful Command spell. Command is WIP and needs to be updated to the current roll system. At the beginning of each combat, you gain 1 Hierophant Spell Point. You may spend it to cast or empower any non-damaging spell you can normally cast. At the end of combat, you lose the Hierophant Spell Point if you have not spent it.

Warden.name: Protector
Warden.html: Protector: You gain proficiency with medium armor. Additionally, your spellcasting is interrupted only after you receive 3 damage instead of 2.

Warden.name: Kindness of God
Warden.html: Kindness of God: You learn the Cure spell. If you already knew it before, you learn another Divine spell that you satisfy the requirements for. When you cast Cure normally as a Fast Action, you may heal two targets, as if you've cast it as a slow, interruptible action.

Worldshaper.name: World Magic
Worldshaper.html: World Magic: You excel at performing druidic magic with ease. You get 1 temporary Spell Point at the beginning of each combat. It can only be used to cast Nature spells. You lose any unspent Spell Points from this feature at the end of combat.

Shephard.name: Multiple Summons
Shephard.html: Multiple Summons: You gain an additional summon slot (increased from 1 to 2).

Werebeast.name: Combat Shifter
Werebeast.html: Combat Shifter: You may shapeshift into Large animals. Additionally, gain 4 Extra Dice on Animal Strike rolls.

Werebeast.name: Wildshape Spellcasting
Werebeast.html: Wildshape Spellcasting: You may cast spells while shapeshifted into Small or larger animals.

Werebeast.name: Wildshape Communication
Werebeast.html: Wildshape Communication: While shapeshifted, you may speak telepathically with any number of creatures within 30 units of you.

Exemplar.name: Touch of Kindness
Exemplar.html: Touch of Kindness: Using Renewal also removes one of the following effects from the target: Discouraged, Frightened, Disoriented.

Exemplar.name: Sphere of Protection
Exemplar.html: Sphere of Protection: You gain the Sphere of Protection action.

Avenger.name: Deliver Judgment
Avenger.html: Deliver Judgment: When you hit an enemy with Holy Smite, they become Marked for Judgment until the end of the combat. If you kill an enemy by performing Holy Smite, choose another enemy you can see. They become Marked for Judgment until the end of the combat. You have 2 Extra Dice with Melee Strikes against those that are Marked for Judgment.

Avenger.name: Pursue the Wicked
Avenger.html: Pursue the Wicked: Once per round, you may spend 1 devotion point to get +2 Movement until the end of the round (no action needed).

Justiciar.name: Holy Decrees
Justiciar.html:
Holy Decrees: You gain the following options to the Rally feature. Decrees require spending devotion points. Rally Options

Decree of the Honorable Duel (Costs 2 Devotion Points): "You must see the fight through to the end." Choose a point within range. Until end of combat, any creature within 10 units of this point that deals damage to another becomes Engaged with that target, and the target becomes Engaged with them. While Engaged, a creature loses 2 HP whenever it targets anyone other than those it is Engaged with. This status ends for both parties only if either creature is reduced to 0 HP. A creature can only be Engaged with one other creature at a time.

Decree of the Fair Fight (2 Devotion Points): "Outnumbering a single opponent is dishonorable." Choose a point within range. Until end of combat, any creature within 10 units of that point that deals damage to a target already damaged by another creature this round loses 2 HP. Swarms and Hordes instead lose 2 hp each time they attack.

Assassin.name: First Blood
Assassin.html: First Blood: On the first round of combat, you get additional 2 Extra Dice with Melee Strikes and Weapon Throws against targets that haven't acted this combat yet.

Fae Trickster.name: Fae Evasion
Fae Trickster.html: Fae Evasion: When you use Evasive Maneuver, you may also immediately teleport a distance up to your Movement score.

Fae Trickster.name: Whimsical Enchantments
Fae Trickster.html: Whimsical Enchantments: You gain the Fae Dust Cloud action.

Toymaker.name: Mechanism Points
Toymaker.html: Mechanism Points: Start each day with 3 Mechanism Points (MP). Spend them to create mechanisms; they fall apart at the end of the day. Some cannot be built during combat.

Toymaker.name: Mechanisms
Toymaker.html:
Mechanisms: The following mechanisms can be created using Mechanism Points (MP):

Clockwork Walker: Costs 1 MP Tiny, 1 HP, movement 3. In combat, acts as a separate actor that you control in the same manner as your character. It makes clicking noises when it is active. You have advantage on Sneak against NPCs who are rolling the walker. Activate the walker by using a Fast Action or by spending 1 Instinct during the Beginning Phase. After two rounds of combat, or twelve seconds, it becomes disabled. When you build the walker, choose its function. You may also modify it to fit a different function later.

Function Jumper: It can use a Fast Action to jump up to two units towards the face of an opponent of a large or smaller size. It distracts them, providing advantage on attacks against them for the same round. After the action, the walker is disabled.

Bomb Carrier: You can put any one bomb in it (you need to provide the bomb from elsewhere). It can use a Fast Action to detonate, destroying itself in the process. The effect of the detonation is according to the bomb's description.

Beartrap: Costs 1 MP Large or smaller creatures that step on the trap receive 1 Piercing damage and become Slowed (1 Drag and -1 Movement) until the end of the next round.

Jumping Boots: Costs 1 MP These crude boots are worn on top of the user's own boots. As part of the wearer's movement, they may jump forward using the boots, moving them 3 units in a straight line in addition to their normal movement. They can also be used to jump 2 units higher as part of a vertical jump. The boots are destroyed after one use. Putting the boots on is a Slow Action.

Ravager.name: Who Needs a Shield
Ravager.html: Who Needs a Shield: Gain +1 Deflection while holding at least one weapon and no shield.

Ravager.name: Basic Dual Wielding
Ravager.html: Basic Dual Wielding: Wield two one-handed weapons, at most one Heavy. Make one Melee Strike roll using both weapons’ Extra Dice, the higher Minimum Roll, one available damage type, and one weapon’s Double 6 effect.

Ravager.name: Bloody Momentum
Ravager.html: Bloody Momentum: When you kill an enemy with a Melee Strike, you get 1 more instinct until the end of the round.

Sentinel.name: None Shall Escape
Sentinel.html: None Shall Escape: You may trigger Opportunity Attacks as if your melee reach was larger by 1 unit. If you do so, move 1 unit towards the target, bringing them into your melee reach.

Sentinel.name: Defender Strikes
Sentinel.html: Defender Strikes: You gain the following options to Tactical Strike Challenge: The target suffers disadvantage on all attacks against targets other than you until the end of the next round.

Witchblade.name: Eldritch Tactics
Witchblade.html:
Eldritch Tactics: You gain the following options to Tactical Strike

Condemn (-1 damage): The target becomes Vulnerable (-1 to all defenses) until the end of the next round.

Sicken: The target becomes Disoriented (1 penalty on all rolls) until the end of the next round. In addition, you may use the Opportunity Attack and Counterstrike features using a cantrip with a range of Touch instead of Melee Strike.

Witchblade.name: Student of the Dark
Witchblade.html: Student of the Dark: You can use the Student of War feature against abominations and fiends as well as humanoids.

Phantasmist.name: Fracture Reality
Phantasmist.html:
Fracture Reality: You gain 1 Fracture Spell Point at the beginning of combat. It can only be used to cast spells that are rolled against Will. When you cast a spell using the Fracture Spell Point, choose one of the following:

Double: if it only has one target, you may immediately perform it again against a second target. You need to spend Spell Points on this additional casting.

Extend: If the spell has a duration, you may increase the duration until the end of the combat You lose the Fracture Spell Point at the end of combat if you have not spent it.

War Mage.name: Battle Casting
War Mage.html: Battle Casting: A cantrip that deals damage and normally has Average speed has Fast speed for you instead.

War Mage.name: Evocation Specialist
War Mage.html: Evocation Specialist: At the beginning of combat, you gain 1 Evocation Spell Point. It may only be used to cast a spell that deals damage. When you cast a spell using the Evocation Spell Point, it counts as if you spent 1 additional Spell Point on that spell. At the end of combat, you lose the Evocation Spell Point if you have not spent it.

Chronomancer.name: Secrets of Chronomancy
Chronomancer.html: Secrets of Chronomancy: You gain access to Chrono spells. Whenever you learn new spells, including when you level up, you may choose from these spells if you satisfy the requirements for them. When you gain this feature, choose two Chrono spells to learn. Use your Magic skill to cast Chrono spells.

Pyre.name: Infernal Rage Aura
Pyre.html: Infernal Rage Aura: During the Beginning Phase of each round, you may activate or deactivate your aura. While it is active, at the end of each round, you and every other creature within 1 unit of you take 1 Fire damage automatically, without a roll. The damage to yourself cannot be mitigated. Gain 1 additional Rage for each other creature that takes damage this way. This stacks with your normal Rage gains from damaging enemies. Damage to yourself grants Rage only through the normal rule for losing HP, with no additional Rage from this feature.

Pyre.name: Flaming Strikes
Pyre.html: Flaming Strikes: When you perform a Melee Strike or Unarmed Strike, you may spend additional Rage to extend its range by 1 unit for each Rage spent. If you spend Rage this way, the Strike deals Fire damage instead of its normal damage type.

Pyre.name: Ultimate: Fiery Eruption
Pyre.html: Fiery Eruption: You gain the Fiery Eruption action.

Berserker.name: Bloodlust
Berserker.html: Bloodlust: When you kill an enemy with Weapon Throw, or an enemy dies within your melee range, you gain 2 temporary hit points. Each enemy's death grants this benefit only once, even if both conditions apply.

Berserker.name: Ultimate: Whirlwind
Berserker.html: Ultimate: Whirlwind: You gain the Whirlwind Melee Strike variant.

Walking Ballista.name: Hardwall
Walking Ballista.html: Hardwall: You gain proficiency with Heavy Armor.

Walking Ballista.name: Deployment
Walking Ballista.html:
Deployment: Use the Deploy Instinct ability to become deployed. While deployed:

  • You gain +1 Deflection and +1 Fortitude.
  • You may use Ballista abilities.
  • You may use only ranged weapons and bombs.
  • You provide Half Cover to adjacent creatures of your size and Full Cover to adjacent creatures smaller than you.
  • You cannot move.
  • You cannot use the Evade Instinct ability.

Walking Ballista.name: Power Shot
Walking Ballista.html: Power Shot: You gain the Power Shot Ranged Strike variant.

Walking Ballista.name: Bomb Slinging
Walking Ballista.html: Bomb Slinging: You gain the Bomb Slinging Bomb Throw variant.

Walking Ballista.name: Caltrops
Walking Ballista.html: Caltrops: You gain the Caltrops Ranged Strike variant.

Bowslinger.name: Moving Target
Bowslinger.html: Moving Target: When you finish moving at least 3 units from your starting position, gain +1 Deflection until the end of the round.

Bowslinger.name: Combat Archery
Bowslinger.html: Combat Archery: Your Ranged Strikes do not suffer disadvantage from being within an enemy's melee reach, and enemies gain no benefit from Half Cover against them.

Bowslinger.name: Multishot
Bowslinger.html: Multishot: You gain the Multishot Ranged Strike variant.

Arcane Archer.name: Elemental Archery
Arcane Archer.html:
Elemental Archery: Whenever you perform a Ranged Strike, you may change its damage type to Fire, Ice, or Lightning. If you do, replace the weapon's Double 6 effect for that Strike with the corresponding effect from Elemental Flare:

  • Fire: the target becomes Burning 1 until the end of the round (it takes 1 Fire damage at the end of the round).
  • Ice: the target becomes Chilled 2 (-2 Movement) until the end of the next round.
  • Lightning: the target becomes Disoriented 1 (a penalty of 1 on all rolls) until the end of the next round.

Arcane Archer.name: Force Arrow
Arcane Archer.html: Force Arrow: You gain the Force Arrow action.

Arcane Archer.name: Exploding Arrow
Arcane Archer.html: Exploding Arrow: You gain the Exploding Arrow action.

Arcane Archer.name: Thunder Arrow
Arcane Archer.html: Thunder Arrow: You gain the Thunder Arrow action.

Defiler.name: Bonus Cantrip
Defiler.html: Bonus Cantrip: You gain an additional Occult cantrip (recorded in Spells Known).

Defiler.name: Vile Spell Point
Defiler.html: Vile Spell Point: At the beginning of each combat, you gain 1 Vile Spell Point. You may spend it only to cast or empower a spell that applies negative conditions. When you spend this point on a spell, increase the level of every negative condition applied by that spell by 1. This increase applies to conditions that have levels. At the end of combat, you lose the Vile Spell Point if you have not spent it.

Human.name: Legacy of Discovery
Human.html: Legacy of Discovery: You are Expert (5d6) in one Standard Skill and Adept (4d6) in another Standard Skill.

Human.name: Origin Feat
Human.html: Origin Feat: You gain one Origin Feat.

Orc.name: Legacy of War
Orc.html: Legacy of War: You are Expert (5d6) in one of the following: Athletics, Leadership, Intimidation, Warfare, Notice Movement, Detect Traps, Medicine, Unarmed, Melee, or Ranged.

Orc.name: Last One Standing (1 / Day)
Orc.html: Last One Standing (1 / Day): When you would be reduced to 0 HP, you are reduced to 1 HP instead.

Orc.name: Battleborn
Orc.html: Battleborn: When you take damage in combat, you become Inspired 1 (1 Extra Die on rolls) until the end of the next round.

High Elf.name: Legacy of the Highborn
High Elf.html: Legacy of the Highborn: You are Expert (5d6) in one of the following: Diplomacy, Leadership, Reasoning, Arcana, History, Politics, Insight, Deduction, Mechanics, or Medicine.

High Elf.name: Knowledge Cramming
High Elf.html: Knowledge Cramming: At the end of a long rest, choose one Standard Skill in which you are untrained. You become Adept (4d6) in it until your next long rest.

High Elf.name: Arcane Affinity I
High Elf.html: Arcane Affinity I: You are Expert (5d6) in Magic and learn two Arcane cantrips of your choice. You may cast them even if you are not trained in a matching tradition.

High Elf.name: Arcane Affinity II
High Elf.html: Arcane Affinity II: You know Arcane Shield, Detect Magic, and Magic Missile. You may cast each of these spells once per day without spending Spell Points, even if you are not trained in a matching tradition. You cannot empower these free castings. If you are trained in a matching tradition, you may also cast these spells normally by spending Spell Points.

Wood Elf.name: Legacy of the Wild
Wood Elf.html: Legacy of the Wild: You are Expert (5d6) in one of the following: Intimidation, Nature, Detect Traps, Find Hidden Paths, Notice Movement, Acrobatics, Animal Handling, Sneak, Survival, or Ranged.

Wood Elf.name: Danger Sense
Wood Elf.html: Danger Sense: During the Beginning Phase of the first round of combat, choose one benefit: Hunt: If you commit to a Fast Action this round, you have advantage on its roll, if it has one. Dodge: Gain +1 Deflection this round. Run: Gain +2 Movement this round.

Wood Elf.name: Wild Tongue
Wood Elf.html: Wild Tongue: You can understand and communicate with land and airborne beasts.

Imp.name: Legacy of Hell
Imp.html: Legacy of Hell: You are Expert (5d6) in one of the following: Charm, Deception, Manipulation, Arcana, Acrobatics, Athletics, Disguise, Performance, Sleight of Hand, or Sneak.

Imp.name: Born of Fire
Imp.html: Born of Fire: You have resistance to Fire damage. When you deal damage with any Strike, you may have it deal Fire damage instead of its normal damage type.

Dwarf.name: Legacy of the Deep Mountains
Dwarf.html: Legacy of the Deep Mountains: You are Expert (5d6) in one of the following: Bartering, Diplomacy, History, Politics, Religion, Warfare, Find Hidden Paths, Find Hidden Objects, Athletics, or Mechanics.

Dwarf.name: The Long Battle
Dwarf.html: The Long Battle: At the beginning of each round, if you are neither Dying nor unconscious, gain temporary HP based on your level: 1 at levels 1–4, 2 at levels 5–7, 3 at levels 8–9, and 4 at level 10.

Dwarf.name: Dwarvish Craftiness
Dwarf.html: Dwarvish Craftiness: Gain proficiency with one Crafting Skill or tool.

Ossian.name: Legacy of the Damned
Ossian.html: Legacy of the Damned: You are Expert (5d6) in one of the following: Deception, Intimidation, Manipulation, Occult, Find Hidden Objects, Find Hidden Paths, Disguise, Sleight of Hand, or Sneak.

Ossian.name: Uncanny
Ossian.html: Uncanny: You have disadvantage on Charm rolls unless disguised and disadvantage on Animal Handling rolls.

Ossian.name: Bonepowder Skin
Ossian.html: Bonepowder Skin: You have resistance to Slashing damage and vulnerability to Crushing damage.

Ossian.name: Occult Affinity I
Ossian.html: Occult Affinity I: You are Expert (5d6) in Magic and learn two Occult cantrips of your choice. You may cast them even if you are not trained in a matching tradition.

Ossian.name: Occult Affinity II
Ossian.html: Occult Affinity II: You know Detect Magic, Eldritch Shield, and Hex. You may cast each of these spells once per day without spending Spell Points, even if you are not trained in a matching tradition. You cannot empower these free castings. If you are trained in a matching tradition, you may also cast these spells normally by spending Spell Points.

Remnant.name: Legacy of the Gods
Remnant.html: Legacy of the Gods: You are Expert (5d6) in one of the following: Charm, Diplomacy, Leadership, History, Religion, Find Hidden Paths, Insight, Athletics, Medicine, or Performance.

Remnant.name: Celestial Levitation
Remnant.html: Celestial Levitation: When you move, you may float a few inches above the ground, ignoring difficult terrain while remaining affected by ground-based environmental hazards. You land when your movement ends. You also fall slowly and take half damage from falling, rounded down.

Remnant.name: Godly Force
Remnant.html: Godly Force: You learn the unique Godly Force cantrip and may cast it even if you are not trained in a matching tradition.

Remnant.name: Divine Affinity I
Remnant.html: Divine Affinity I: You are Expert (5d6) in Magic and learn two Divine cantrips of your choice. You may cast them even if you are not trained in a matching tradition.

Remnant.name: Divine Affinity II
Remnant.html: Divine Affinity II: You know Detect Magic, Healing Touch, and Shield of Faith. You may cast each of these spells once per day without spending Spell Points, even if you are not trained in a matching tradition. You cannot empower these free castings. If you are trained in a matching tradition, you may also cast these spells normally by spending Spell Points.

concoctions.Toughskin Potion: Toughskin Potion: Costs 3 CP +1 Deflection until the end of combat or for one minute.
concoctions.Fire Resistance Potion: Fire Resistance Potion: Costs 1 CP You get Fire resistance until the end of combat or for one minute.
concoctions.Acid Resistance Potion: Acid Resistance Potion: Costs 1 CP You get Acid resistance until the end of combat or for one minute.
concoctions.Poison Resistance Potion: Poison Resistance Potion: Costs 1 CP You get Poison resistance until the end of combat or for one minute.
concoctions.Basic Healing Potion: Basic Healing Potion: Costs 1 CP Heals for one HP.
concoctions.Poison Bomb: Poison Bomb: Costs 1 CP Area: 2 units square Bomb Throw roll against Fortitude. Threshold is 1. Creatures you've succeeded against suffer 1 Poison damage and are Discouraged (-1 damage on attacks) until the end of the next round.
concoctions.Nerve Gas Bomb: Nerve Gas Bomb: Costs 1 CP Area: 2 units square Bomb Throw roll against Fortitude. Creatures you've succeeded against become Vulnerable (-1 to all defenses) until the end of the next round.
concoctions.Burning Bomb: Burning Bomb: Costs 2 CP Area: 2 units square Bomb Throw roll against Deflection. Targets you succeed against receive 1 Fire damage. They also start Burning for 1 damage until the end of the next round (at the end of each round, they suffer 1 Fire damage unless they perform a Fast Action to put out the fire.)
concoctions.Acid Coating: Acid Coating: Costs 1 CP Applies to one Melee Strike or Ranged Strike. Gain 2 Extra Dice on the strike's roll. Its damage type becomes Acid.
concoctions.Nerve Coating: Nerve Coating: Costs 1 CP Applies to one Melee Strike or Ranged Strike. Effect starts after the strike. On hit, the target becomes Vulnerable (-1 to all defenses) until the end of the next round.
